exposure: balloon occlusion of the abdominal aorta before delivery and transverse incision
balloon occlusion of the abdominal aorta after delivery and uterine incision
cohort: 79 women with pernicious placenta previa complicated with placenta accreta
finding: Balloon occlusion of the abdominal aorta before delivery combined with a transverse incision was associated with reduced blood loss and blood product utilisation.
